# Disagreement brief (one page)

Each person who disagrees fills in one copy, alone, before the group meets. Keep it to one page. Write facts a stranger could check.

Name and role:
Date:
Decision this brief is about:

## 1. The problem in business terms
What does the business need, and which decision will the result support? Do not name a technology here.

## 2. My constraint
What I believe cannot be done, or cannot be done safely, in the way proposed. State it as a constraint (a limit, a date, a rule), not as a verdict ("not feasible").

## 3. Evidence
What I have seen, measured or read that supports the constraint. Link logs, queries, documents or numbers.

## 4. What would change my mind
One or two specific findings that would make me drop or relax the constraint.

## 5. Options I can accept
At least two options I could live with, including one I did not propose. For each, one line on what it costs me.
